findings.note: DESK #160 (owner, 2026-09-12). His rule: "the Archives PAGE is the authority, not its search facet, when the two disagree" — he read both pages off the live site and pasted the screenshot of https://2e.aonprd.com/Feats.aspx?ID=9350. TWO RECORDS, one defect each, both in the export's `data.prerequisite` facet rather than in anything Heroes Heaven derived: (1) feat-9350 Soulforger Dedication carries the facet " or ability to cast divine spells" — a fragment beginning with a connector, i.e. the first half of the clause is simply gone — while the printed page (Impossible Magic pg. 98: traits Uncommon / Archetype / Dedication, Source, Archetype Soulforger, then the body) prints NO Prerequisites line at all; his words, "there isnt a prerequisite". So the record's prerequisites become []. (2) feat-9073 Dimensional Disappearance carries "_dimensional assault_ focus spell,; laughing shadow hybrid study" — AoN's own separator came out as ",;", so our splitter kept the stray comma on the end of the first clause and shipped "dimensional assault focus spell,". Both prerequisites are real and stay; only the punctuation goes. ⚠ THIS IS NOT DISPLAY TEXT: checkPrerequisites() in src/rules/build.ts parses each clause with anchored patterns, so a trailing comma is a gate that never matches and an invented clause is a feat a legal character cannot take. ⚠ THE IMPORTER RULE HE ASKED FOR IS NOT IN THIS SPEC. Measured over the whole export (45,500 docs) before wiring it: a facet that STARTS with a connector is exactly 2 documents — feat-9350 and archetype-393 (the Soulforger archetype page, which repeats the same broken facet and ships as archetype/soulforger); a clause left with a TRAILING comma is exactly 2 more — feat-9073 and feat-7287 (Mythic Counterspell, "Quick Recognition; ability to cast spells from spell slots,; Sage's Calling", shipping as feats/mythic-counterspell). Four records, two of which the owner did not rule on, so the change to scripts/lib/aon-facets.mjs prerequisitesFrom() is held for the orchestrator's go and only these two rows ship. The two rows are the fix either way: the overlay is applied after the importer, so it wins whether or not the parser is changed.

backfillRows.why: feat-9350 (Soulforger Dedication, Impossible Magic pg. 98). The live Archives page prints Uncommon / Archetype / Dedication, Source, "Archetype Soulforger" and then the feat's body, with NO Prerequisites line — the owner pasted the screenshot on 2026-09-12 and ruled "there isnt a prerequisite". The export's search facet for the same document is the fragment " or ability to cast divine spells", which begins with a connector: the first half of the clause is missing upstream, so the facet is damage, not a rule. Desk #160; his standing rule is that the page beats its own facet when the two disagree.

feat-9073 (Dimensional Disappearance). The page prints two prerequisites and both are kept — only the punctuation changes. The export's facet is "_dimensional assault_ focus spell,; laughing shadow hybrid study": AoN wrote its clause separator as ",;", and prerequisitesFrom() splits on ';' alone, so the first clause shipped as "dimensional assault focus spell," with a trailing comma. checkPrerequisites() (src/rules/build.ts) matches clauses with anchored patterns, so that comma silently switched the gate off. Owner ruling 2026-09-12, desk #160: "keep both prerequisites, drop the stray comma".
